answer: A concrete rule the ledger can enforce: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because haven only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, plume is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any whisper approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
